versions.text: (a) An applicant must comply with this CS using an acceptable means of compliance (AMC) issued by EASA, or another means of compliance which may include consensus standards, when specifically accepted by EASA. (b) An applicant requesting EASA to accept a means of compliance must provide the means of compliance to EASA in an acceptable form and manner.

provenance.notes: text from 'CS-23 Amendment 5 and AMC & GM to CS-23 Issue 3' (2020-07-01)
